validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="a">
  <datamodel><data id="x" expr="1"/></datamodel>
  <state id="a"><onentry><if cond="x == 1"><log expr="'one'"/><else/><log expr="'other'"/><elseif cond="x == 2"/><log expr="'two'"/></if></onentry>
  <transition event="go" target="f"/></state><final id="f"/>
</scxml>

notes: the W3C SCXML 1.0 schema rejects this under XML Schema constraint `cvc-complex-type.2.4`: Element 'elseif' is not allowed at this position in the content model
diagnostics.help: `<else>` must be the last branch of `<if>`: move this `<elseif>` and its content before `<else>`
spec_references: XML Schema 1.0 Part 1 §3.4.4 Element Locally Valid (Complex Type) (`cvc-complex-type.2.4`)
